## Overview

This 2026-11-07 snapshot of the [[adyen]] Management API `latest` POST reference lists the v3 TEST server for creating a split configuration profile under the merchant account identified by required path `merchantId`. An API credential with **Management API - SplitConfiguration read and write** is required. The profile is intended for automatic payment splits only after it is associated with a store in that merchant account; the described split is between the platform's liable balance account and the user's balance account.

## Key takeaways

- The request body requires `description` and a `rules` array. Each rule requires `currency`, `fundingSource`, `paymentMethod`, `shopperInteraction`, and a `splitLogic` object; within that object, `commission` is marked required. `cardRegion` and `cardUsageType` are optional conditions; `cardUsageType` defaults to `ANY` in this API table. The 2026-09-15 [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-automatic-split-configuration|automatic-split overview]] labels card usage type a pilot unavailable to some platforms. See the pinned table for allowed values and fee, refund, chargeback, tip, remainder, and commission details.
- If no transaction fee type is included in `splitLogic`, the reference says Adyen updates the payment request with `paymentFee`, booking all transaction fees to the platform liable balance account. The `dcc` field is described as a pilot, unavailable to some platforms.
- A `200` response describes the profile with `description` and `rules`, while `splitConfigurationId`, rule `ruleId`, and `splitLogicId` are marked optional in the response schema. `204` is successful processing with no content. Neither response proves store association, a matched payment, booking, settlement, or payout.

> [!warning] Contradiction
> The request and response `currency` tables say a three-character ISO currency code is required (raw lines 31, 97), but both JSON examples set `currency` to `ANY` (lines 65, 237). The 2026-09-15 [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-automatic-split-configuration-create-split-configuration|creation guide]] explicitly instructs `ANY` for any currency (its raw line 121). These sources conflict; neither the example nor the older guide establishes current API acceptance.

quotes.text: Creates a split configuration profile to [split payments automatically](https://docs.adyen.com/platforms/automatic-split-configuration/). After you [associate it with a store](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/Management/latest/patch/merchants/(merchantId)/stores/(storeId)#request-splitConfiguration) in your merchant account, it splits the funds of all transactions processed through that store between your liable balance account and [your user's balance account](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/Management/latest/patch/merchants/(merchantId)/stores/(storeId)#request-splitConfiguration-balanceAccountId).
- Management API - SplitConfiguration read and write
|   - currency | string | Yes | The currency condition that defines whether the split logic applies. Its value must be a three-character [ISO currency code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217). |

If you don't include at least one transaction fee type in the `splitLogic` object, Adyen updates the payment request with the `paymentFee` parameter, booking all transaction fees to your platform's liable balance account.
The request has been successfully processed, but there is no additional content.
